text: {"findings":[{"type":"PRIOR_ART","title":"Repeats EXP-014 (10-minute ETA buffer) without referencing it","detail":"EXP-014 already tested a 10-minute buffer on promised windows. It raised On-Time Delivery Rate by 3.1 pts, but the gain came from relaxed promises, checkout conversion fell 1.2%, and it was not shipped. The proposal doesn't cite it or address its learning to judge promise changes on Promise Accuracy and conversion, and it has no conversion guardrail.","evidence_quote":"Add a 10-minute buffer to promise windows in the three worst-performing zones to lift on-time rate.","citations":["experiment-registry#exp-014-eta-buffer"],"recommendation":"Reference EXP-014 and explain what differs this time (for example, targeting only the three worst zones). Add checkout conversion as a guardrail, and treat Promise Accuracy as a co-primary metric so an OTD gain from looser promises isn't counted as a win."}]}
